_comment_rules: Each rule states its class, review status (reviewed | provisional | withdrawn; withdrawn rules are kept for the record and never loaded), where it comes from (source) and the rules version that added it. 'ambiguous' marks names that are also ordinary words or legitimate products: they match program or archive names only and never count above MEDIUM. Dual-use tools (debuggers, memory editors) are INFO context. hashes is empty on purpose: no hash is added without a sample a maintainer classified (docs/rules-pipeline.md).

_comment_offsetStrings: dw... names come from offset dumps and match as substrings. m_... names are the game's own fields, also found in legitimate Source-engine tools (demo/movie tools, server plugins, SDK code); they match whole identifiers only (m_iHealthMax is not m_iHealth). FileInspection: one field name alone is LOW (shown, does not ask for review); a dump name or two distinct names MEDIUM; three or more HIGH. Measured in docs/validation.md.

_comment_allowlist: Identity for heuristic findings only (offset strings, injection imports, entropy, disguised extension, unknown streams). A file counts as identified when Windows reports a valid signature, its chain ends in one of trustedRoots (pinned by SHA-1; each entry says where the thumbprint was taken from) and the signer's CN or O equals one of allowSigners exactly, or when its SHA-256 is in allowHashes. Locations are no longer an allowlist: see checks/Locations.java. Exact cheat-name and hash matches are always reported.
